#### 208: Discrete Structures
> Traditional math for a computer science major, Calculus 1 is a prerequisite. Covers proof techniques among other things. 

#### 301: Analysis of Algorithms
> Covers advanced algorithms and data structures, and thorough understanding of runtime and space analysis. Prerequisites include Discrete structures and Data Structures (CS 207 at Grinnell).

#### 331: Algorithms, Ethics, and Society
> We attempt to understand the ramifications of technology on society, especially focused on the lens of identity. Prerequisites include Data Structures (CS 207 at Grinnell).
Fall 2025, Fall 2023

#### 341: Automata, Formal Languages, and Computational Complexity
> Covers Regular Languages, Turing Machines, Complexity Theory, Undecidability, etc. Prerequisites include Discrete structures and Data Structures (CS 207 at Grinnell).

#### Tutorial
> This is the first semester course at Grinnell College that all students are required to take. Faculty teach writing, speaking, and research fundamentals through a topic of their choice. Fall 2021
